svg.text: n_hidden 512 (registers) · c_context 384 · 7×7 grid · depth 8 · 5 context DFFs, cascade 256 / 64 / 16 / 4 / 1 · RESET at every <NUL> · frozen ResNet-50 on the 2 fps frame · frozen Mimi audio grid · one step per caption token · batch 250 · SGD lr 1e-4 → 0.01 (cosine, 20K) · 50/50 FineWeb / FineVideo
the 2 fps frame on screen at the token's media time, held until the
next is due · one crop offset per example · text rows: image grid = 0
next token → fed back as the next step's input (autoregressive)
W1 = 256 (slow: scene / topic within an example) · 25K MAC
W5 = 1 (plain write, no MAC) · 25K subtract · S_1..S_4: 3×25K adds
dashed: old state r (Q) into each EMA · open circle R: reset to 0 at every example's <NUL> (--continuous '', --init zero) · S_k: running sum of the new values
each read through its own 512-channel block of ctx_cat
v426 vs v405: captioned video with sound, registers reset per example, FineWeb text
video: FineVideo (43,751 YouTube videos, CC-BY), precomputed: JPEG frames at 2 fps (short
side 224), Mimi codes, and timed events = activity descriptions + quoted transcript lines
token clock (phase A): one step per caption token, each placed at its media time — a speech
token where it has just been heard, an activity line all at its start (a scene header)
image: frozen ResNet-50 sees the 2 fps frame on screen then, held until the next frame is due
audio: frozen Kyutai Mimi (24 kHz, 12.5 Hz, 32-codebook RVQ); latents = quantizer.decode(codes)
grid = the last 49 latent frames (3.9 s heard) laid row-major on 7×7, RMS-normalized per position
ctx_cat's image and audio blocks start at zero · text rows: image grid = audio grid = 0
<NUL> (id −1) opens every example: token, image and audio grids = 0, registers reset to 0 —
ctx_cat's whole input is zero, so the first token is predicted from its bias alone
rows start staggered (random position in their first example): no all-<NUL> batch for BN
cascade as v405: DFF_1 ← EMA_256(x) · DFF_k ← EMA_Wk(x − S_k−1), S_k−1 = DFF_1[t] + … + DFF_k−1[t]
exact reconstruction: DFF_1 + … + DFF_5 = x every step (registers detached: 1-step gradient)
read side: DFF_k × 1/σ_k, σ_k = running batch RMS — a constant at inference, folds into ctx_cat
training rows: 50% FineWeb sample-10BT text, 50% FineVideo (id-hash 1/32 held out)
eval: FineWeb + 64 held-out FineVideo videos, each with sound + picture / sound only / picture only / neither
frozen: embedding / inverse embedding (pythia-31m), ResNet-50, Mimi audio encoder
channel concatenation (token + image + audio grids + 5 registers)
conv 3×3 unpadded (linear, no BN/ReLU): dec_tree.0, dec_tree.1, decoder.proj
media input: 2 fps video frame / 24 kHz audio (precomputed per video)
EMA multiply-accumulate, rate 1/W_k (fixed: 256, 64, 16, 4; DFF_5 is a plain write)
subtractor (−) / adder (+): x minus S_k, the running sum of the slower registers
read scale 1/σ_k (running RMS; constant at inference) · RMS: per-position norm
D flip-flop, clocked once per token step; R = synchronous reset to 0 at <NUL>
data / state path (labelled where it matters)
old register value r into its EMA
Per token: ≈680M conv MAC (520M ContextCNN, 111M 1×1s, 35M decoder, 13M lmhead)
+ 4.1G MAC frozen ResNet-50 per new 2 fps frame (training re-runs it every step) · Mimi at 12.5 Hz
+ 100K EMA MAC + 100K subtracts + 75K adds; state 5 × 512 × 7 × 7 = 125K values
Trainable 15.25M · frozen 128.6M (embed 12.9M, lmhead 12.9M, ResNet-50 23.6M, Mimi 79.3M) · 5 RMS constants
